The '''Bezzard farm''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] it was owned by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] [[Tellico Bezzard|Tellico]] and [[Tyla Bezzard]], who resided there with their [[Tellico Bezzard's son|son]].<ref name="Kenobi" /> The farm was located near the rocky region known as the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], between a pass in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]] to the northeast.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-world-of-star-wars-kenobi|text=The World of ''Star Wars: Kenobi''|nolive=1}}</ref>
